 TL;DR  
 Bitcoin holds above $83,400 after a morning attempt at $87,000. Derivatives liquidations total $286.46 million, and 73.4% of the losses are on short sellers. 
 Evernorth (XRPN) files with the SEC to register up to 11.5 million shares tied to $11.50 warrants. Full exercise would raise $132.2 million for XRP reserves. 
 The OCC’s final GENIUS Act rule bans yield on stablecoins from January 18, 2027. Yield programs at Coinbase, PayPal, and Kraken move to case-by-case review.

 The crypto market opens Wednesday's trading, October 21, with a large-scale liquidation of derivatives contracts worth $286.46 million, holding Bitcoin's price above $83,400 after a morning attempt to storm the $87,000 mark.
 The flagship's dominance stands at 60.14%, amid a daily net inflow of $21.18 million into US spot ETFs, which raises the cumulative liquidity volume in the funds to $23.43 billion. The largest altcoins are rising in sync: Ethereum is testing the $2,464 mark with a daily gain of 3.4%, while Solana and BNB are adding 2.5% on average.
 The incoming capital is effectively absorbing the circulating spot supply, creating a local shortage of coins on exchanges. The resulting imbalance is triggering a cascade of forced closures of margin positions right now, with sellers (Short) accounting for 73.4% of all losses as per CoinGlass .

 XRP, Shiba Inu (SHIB), Tron (TRX) and Solana (SOL) Price Analysis For October 21: When Do Headliners Pick Up Bullish Pace? 
 By Arman Shirinyan 
 Against this macroeconomic backdrop, fundamental events are unfolding that are changing the landscape of regulatory relations and the commercial use of digital assets in the US. The SEC approves Evernorth's corporate application, opening legal gateways for raising capital through the XRP Treasury program.
 The US Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) issues the first implementing rules for stablecoin issuers under the GENIUS Act. At the same time, the industry is responding to emergency cybersecurity challenges and the reorganization of the Dogecoin ecosystem, which forces market operators to act without delay.
 A new SEC precedent. Capital enters XRP directly through exchange-traded warrants
 Market participants are analyzing the disclosed regulatory documents of Evernorth (XRPN), a XRP treasury company listed on Nasdaq . The firm, which went public in October 2026, is filing an application with the SEC to issue up to 11.5 million common shares tied to public warrants with an exercise price of $11.50 per unit. If these contracts are fully exercised, the capital raised will amount to $132.2 million.
 The entire amount of funds raised is directed toward increasing the company's corporate XRP token reserves per share. Market orders are planned to be executed through regulated partners, Ripple and Coinbase. Evernorth currently holds 473 million XRP, worth about $638 million, and $300 million in free fiat cash on its balance sheet.
 Evernorth registers 11.5 million shares with the SEC under Rule 424b3 for public warrant execution at $11.50 per share, Source: Evernorth / SEC Edgar

 Tue, 10/20/2026 - 20:56 
 XRP Treasury Stock XRPN Now Available on Uphold 
 By Alex Dovbnya 
 The Digital Asset Treasury (DAT) concept being introduced effectively transfers MicroStrategy's accumulation model to the largest altcoins. Traders regard the SEC's approval as a long-term bullish signal confirming the asset's legal status.
 At the same time, Wall Street analysts emphasize that registering the documents is a standard procedure. It does not mean automatic market purchases right this second, since the final result depends on market volatility and the decisions of warrant holders.
 Stablecoin yields banned, while Solana speeds up 85 times. What else happened this morning
 The US Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) publishes the final implementing rule under the federal GENIUS Act. The document introduces uniform standards for stablecoin issuers, which will officially take effect on January 18, 2027.
 The regulation sets strict requirements for reserves, custody, redemption procedures, risk, and auditing, and introduces a direct ban on paying interest or investment yield for holding coins. Existing yield programs on the exchanges Coinbase, PayPal, and Kraken are being moved by the regulator to a regime of case-by-case review.
 At the @USOCC, we have worked diligently and expeditiously to deliver the GENIUS Act final rule ahead of schedule to support President Trump's vision and @SecScottBessent's leadership to grow the economy and lead the global digital currency revolution. 
Today marks the birth of a new industry having a federal framework for payment stablecoins in the digital age. It also brings us back to our original mission when the OCC was charged with the responsibility for organizing and administering a system of nationally chartered banks and a uniform national currency.
— Comptroller Jonathan V. Gould (@USComptroller) October 21, 2026 
 In parallel, large-scale technological shifts and records are being registered in the decentralized network sector:
 Ethereum staking: The volume of locked ETH stands at 43.8 million coins ($107.2 billion), with 35.9% of the entire market supply locked in staking. Net inflow over 9 months has grown 6.1 times thanks to institutional players such as BitMine, whose share reaches 5.07 million ETH. The annual validator yield against this background is 2.63%.
 Solana Alpenglow consensus: Today, in epoch 1064, the network activates the largest consensus upgrade in its history. Transaction finality time will shrink from ~12.8 seconds to ~150 milliseconds, speeding up processing 85 times. The switchover process is not reflected in the wallets of ordinary users and stakers.
 Dogecoin Labs launch: The company, backed by the Dogecoin Foundation, is consolidating the MyDoge, DogeOS, and Such App teams. Under CEO Jordan Jefferson, the DogeOS EVM testnet, launched on September 30, is being developed, where the native DOGE token is used as gas to pay for transactions of DeFi applications. The coin's price is $0.08.
 Zcash NU7 hard fork: The ZEC rate is trading up 12% on the day near the $1,270 mark, amid whales opening 10x leveraged long positions worth $37.57 million. Market participants are pricing in expectations of the NU7 update scheduled for November 5, which will reduce block time to 25 seconds and introduce one-time viewing keys for cross-chain swaps via Zakura and NEAR Intents.

 Wed, 10/21/2026 - 10:47 
 Tom Lee's BitMine Stakes Nearly $400 Million in Ethereum 
 By Caroline Amosun 
 This price momentum is right now causing a cascade of forced closures of short positions on derivatives exchanges, totaling $286.46 million over 24 hours. Ethereum remains the epicenter of the squeeze , with $90.62 million in liquidations, followed by Bitcoin with $66.67 million, while 51% of the closure volume is processed by the Binance exchange.
 Meanwhile, the IT departments of crypto exchanges and DeFi services are assessing systemic risk: the PHP Foundation is issuing an emergency warning about a CVSS 9.2 vulnerability in the session.upload_progress module. Due to active attacks, the GrapheneOS forums and Dutch government portals have temporarily gone offline, so IT services are advised to disable the function in php.ini.
 "Golden cross" vs. negative premium. What to expect from the market in the coming days
 The current configuration of the cryptocurrency market points to the preservation of bullish potential, supported by on-chain metrics. CryptoQuant CEO Ki Young Ju confirms the long-term nature of the trend, noting steady growth in the realized capitalization of the Bitcoin network, which is occurring in a bull market.
 Fresh capital is flowing into Bitcoin. This only happens in bull markets. https://t.co/T7a6i1MvmB
— Ki Young Ju (@ki_young_ju) October 21, 2026 
 Institutional spot funds serve as the long-term foundation of liquidity: the daily net inflow into BTC ETFs is +$23.54 million, and into ETH ETFs, +$16.13 million. Flows into Solana ETFs are holding at +$104.10 thousand, while the XRP, ZEC, LINK, and DOGE sectors so far show neutral zero changes.
 Key markers to pay attention to right now: 
 "Golden Cross" pattern: On Bitcoin's daily chart, the 50-day EMA has crossed above the 200-day EMA. This technical signal has historically preceded a parabolic uptrend.
 Resistance test: To continue the uptrend toward the technical target of $94,000, BTC's price needs to break through and hold on the hourly timeframe above the 84,500–85,000 resistance zone.
 Coinbase Premium: The indicator of the price difference has dropped to -0.11%, updating its low since early July. The passivity of the US spot market, amid the flushing out of shorts on Binance, has historically signaled the end of local consolidations and preparation for a new price push.
